theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+0.33%) and Real Estate (+0.18%) led the market today, while Health Care (-2.01%) and Industrials (-1.56%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.97%, defensives -1.33%, and value/cyclicals -0.44% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.87%, Dow -1.32%, Nasdaq -1.00% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -1.34%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 7.52% to 16.01, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.43% to $4,575.10, crude oil was little changed at $86.21, and bitcoin gained 4.91% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
